mapper.select: select cast(id as varchar) as id, email, password_hash, display_name, enabled, email_verified, created_at, updated_at from users where lower(email) = lower(#{email})
select cast(id as varchar) as id, email, password_hash, display_name, enabled, email_verified, created_at, updated_at from users where id = cast(#{id} as uuid)
mapper.insert: insert into users (id, email, password_hash, display_name, enabled, email_verified) values (cast(#{id} as uuid), #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{enabled}, #{emailVerified})
insert into user_roles (user_id, role) values (cast(#{userId} as uuid), #{role})
mapper.select: select role from user_roles where user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) order by role
mapper.update: update users set enabled = true, email_verified = true, updated_at = current_timestamp where lower(email) = lower(#{email})
update users set password_hash = #{passwordHash}, updated_at = current_timestamp where id = cast(#{id} as uuid) and enabled = true
